title: Amazon Bedrock Short-term API key (bedrock-api-key-): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: bedrock-api-keys- (plural) in place of bedrock-api-key-, prefix: one character of the fixed 133-character head changed, inside its first 28 characters, and prefix: the documented lower-case bedrock-api-key- capitalized. Twin of "Amazon Bedrock Short-term API key (bedrock-api-key-): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of aws-bedrock-short-term-api-key-curl-bearer: prefix: bedrock-api-keys- (plural) in place of bedrock-api-key-. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
